title: A.T.L.A.S and TranscriptionSync: code and evaluation scripts for training-free lip synchronization of native-audio LLMs
description: A.T.L.A.S extends the open-source Atlas-MK37 personal assistant by FatihMakes (https://github.com/FatihMakes/Atlas-MK37, CC BY-NC 4.0) with a browser VRM avatar, the TranscriptionSync lip-synchronization pipeline and the experiment scripts of the revised evaluation (paper/revision): wall-clock Layer-1 latency, streaming CTC alignment of the Live API transcription, video-measured GRID evaluation including an Audio2Face-3D port, re-trained audio-to-blendshape regressors, SyncNet offset tests and a re-collected Gemini Live evaluation (English and Turkish). Licensing: base code and modifications CC BY-NC 4.0; paper/revision scripts MIT. No datasets or model weights are included. Version 1.0.0 of this record was published with incorrect license metadata (MIT); the base code is CC BY-NC 4.0.
